raw_segments.text: It was, perhaps, rather early in the morning to get up a concert, and the audience prematurely
aroused from their slumbers might not possibly pay their entertainer with coin bearing the
Passapartout therefore decided to wait several hours, and as he was sauntering along, it
occurred to him that he would seem rather too well-dressed for a wandering artist.
The idea struck him to change his garments for clothes more in harmony with his project,
by which he might also get a little money to satisfy the immediate cravings of hunger.
The resolution taken, it remained to carry it out.
